we propose a ConvL model for the classification of MOOC forum posts.

how to automatically identify whether the learner expresses confusion, how to determine the urgency of the confusion and how to identify the sentiment of the learner’s confusion.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ConvL can automatically identify the confusion, urgency and sentiment of a post in MOOC discussion forum, which can be used to help instructors and learners.

we have proposed a novel deep learning framework for cross domain MOOC forum post classification and demonstrated that our model can effectively learn the feature representation of posts and classify the post urgency and sentiment.
we proposed a transfer learning framework to address the cross domain problem of post classification in MOOC forums.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a convolutional LSTM can be effectively applied to cross domain MOOC forum post classification.
a convolution LSTM can effectively learn features for posts and the parameters learned in one course can be effectively transferred to another course.
it is feasible to use a deep learning approach to automatically identify the confusion and urgency in a forum and classify the sentiment of posts.
